Walnut Private Equity Partners Position in Oneok New (OKE) Has Boosted by $312,000; As Paycom Software (PAYC) Share Value Rose, Bridgecreek Investment Management Lowered Its Holding 
April 15, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia 
Walnut Private Equity Partners Llc increased its stake in Oneok Inc New (OKE) by 4.2% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Walnut Private Equity Partners Llc bought 6,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 7.05% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 148,995 shares of the public utilities company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.77 million, up from 142,995 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Walnut Private Equity Partners Llc who had been investing in Oneok Inc New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $24.03B market cap company. The stock increased 0.33% or $0.19 during the last trading session, reaching $58.51. About 1.60M shares traded. ONEOK, Inc. (NYSE:OKE) has risen 7.29% since April 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 4.26% the S&P500. 
Bridgecreek Investment Management Llc decreased its stake in Paycom Software Inc (PAYC) by 2.57% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bridgecreek Investment Management Llc sold 3,890 shares as the company’s stock rose 33.33% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 147,450 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $11.85M, down from 151,340 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bridgecreek Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Paycom Software Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $6.50 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.35% or $1.5 during the last trading session, reaching $109.96. About 744,211 shares traded. Paycom Software, Inc. (NYSE:PAYC) has risen 92.63% since April 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 81.08% the S&P500. 
Bridgecreek Investment Management Llc, which manages about $625.00M and $425.65 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Ishares Tr Msci Eafe Index (EFA) by 34,185 shares to 86,922 shares, valued at $6.11M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Intuitive Surgical Inc (NASDAQ:ISRG) by 21,185 shares in the quarter, for a total of 32,125 shares, and has risen its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL). 
Analysts await Paycom Software, Inc. (NYSE:PAYC) to report earnings on May, 1. They expect $0.78 EPS, up 77.27% or $0.34 from last year’s $0.44 per share. PAYC’s profit will be $46.07 million for 35.24 P/E if the $0.78 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.24 actual EPS reported by Paycom Software, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 225.00% EPS growth. 
Among 18 analysts covering Paycom Software ( NYSE:PAYC ), 12 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 6 Hold. Therefore 67% are positive. Paycom Software had 66 analyst reports since August 5, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Northland Capital initiated the shares of PAYC in report on Thursday, September 21 with “Buy” rating. On Thursday, October 19 the stock rating was maintained by Jefferies with “Buy”. Canaccord Genuity maintained it with “Buy” rating and $85 target in Wednesday, August 2 report. Wells Fargo maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Wednesday, November 1 report. As per Tuesday, September 13, the company rating was maintained by Barclays Capital. Robert W. Baird initiated the shares of PAYC in report on Thursday, January 7 with “Outperform” rating. Northland Capital maintained the shares of PAYC in report on Thursday, January 11 with “Buy” rating. On Tuesday, January 23 the stock rating was maintained by Mizuho with “Hold”. The rating was maintained by Stifel Nicolaus on Wednesday, August 5 with “Buy”. The stock of Paycom Software, Inc. (NYSE:PAYC) has “Overweight” rating given on Tuesday, February 13 by KeyBanc Capital Markets. 
Among 20 analysts covering ONEOK ( NYSE:OKE ), 9 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 11 Hold. Therefore 45% are positive. ONEOK had 73 analyst reports since August 11, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Argus Research downgraded the shares of OKE in report on Friday, June 17 to “Hold” rating. Jefferies downgraded the shares of OKE in report on Thursday, January 12 to “Underperform” rating. The stock of ONEOK, Inc. (NYSE:OKE) earned “Outperform” rating by Credit Suisse on Thursday, December 31. The stock of ONEOK, Inc. (NYSE:OKE) earned “Buy” rating by Wells Fargo on Thursday, January 11. The stock of ONEOK, Inc. (NYSE:OKE) earned “Overweight” rating by Morgan Stanley on Wednesday, January 20. The firm has “Hold” rating by Stifel Nicolaus given on Monday, August 14. The firm earned “Equal-Weight” rating on Wednesday, July 5 by Morgan Stanley. The firm earned “Neutral” rating on Wednesday, January 25 by Citigroup. The stock of ONEOK, Inc. (NYSE:OKE) earned “Buy” rating by BMO Capital Markets on Tuesday, October 17. The rating was downgraded by Robert W. Baird to “Neutral” on Monday, February 8. 
Walnut Private Equity Partners Llc, which manages about $144.96M and $121.72 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Targa Resources Corp (NYSE:TRGP) by 35,000 shares to 81,689 shares, valued at $3.70M in 2017Q4, according to the filing.
